summary: Control Room FASE 2 tested end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 new pytest pass (access 402/404/403, sectors, posts CRUD+duplicate+position 409, resources incl. GPS non_collegato + external-vehicle authorization, staff import no-duplicates, presence/presidio, status KPIs/alerts, interventions open/close, settings+categories, rev polling) + Phase-1 regression 14/14 pass. UI (admin A, desktop 1920): dashboard/topbar/live clock/8 KPIs, GPX route with start/finish + km markers, sector create+highlight+summary, place post on map (lat/lng prefilled) + marker, drag post (coords saved, version++), edit/duplicate/delete, polizia without authorization -> error toast then OK, status buttons -> KPIs + Avvisi, staff import with caposquadra (imported people disappear from list), presence -> PARZIALMENTE PRESIDIATA -> PRESIDIATA + KPI, NUOVO INTERVENTO + close, all filters/search/chips, event status select, settings (responsabile, add/rename category), realtime via API visible in ~3.5s, offline banner shows/hides. Found 3 bugs: (1) collaboratore in non-primary org sees no events on /control-room (Phase-1 list ignores X-Org-Id), (2) map fullscreen not real fullscreen (ancestor transform), (3) vehicle/team markers fully cover post markers.

critical.issue: Uses deps['get_current_user'] which does NOT resolve the X-Org-Id membership context (only require_admin does). Collaboratore C with X-Org-Id=org A gets {events: [], can_purchase: true} (events/role of their primary org C) while GET /api/events and /ops correctly return org A data. Result: in UI, C switched to 'TEST_CR Org a' sees 'Crea prima un evento in Eventi.' and can never reach the read-only dashboard; can_purchase is also computed on the wrong org role. Fix: use the same org-resolving dependency as /ops (require_admin + ROUTE_RULES entry allowing members, or a member dependency that applies X-Org-Id).

minor.issue: Full-replace semantics: any field not sent is reset to default/None (e.g. sending a post without 'codice' wipes codice). Frontend sends full object so OK today, but API consumers can lose data; consider PATCH semantics or document.
No check that resource kind == persona and no optimistic version check (other writes use version).

ui_bugs.issue: 'fixed inset-0 z-50' is contained by ancestor [data-testid=control-room-page] which has class animate-fade-up (computed transform matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0) creates a containing block). Desktop: sidebar+header remain, map height 1112px > viewport so bottom controls off-screen. Mobile 390: wrap at y=-212 (relative to scrolled page), exit-fullscreen button off-screen. Fix: render fullscreen wrapper with createPortal(document.body) or remove transform/animation-fill on the page ancestor.

node.style.transform='translate(14px,-14px)' is overwritten by maplibre's own marker transform, so vehicle/team markers sit exactly on top of their post marker (identical bounding boxes measured) -> post icon hidden and unclickable (e.g. AMB1 hides 'Ristoro km 2', TEST polizia hid its post). Fix: pass offset:[14,-14] to new maplibregl.Marker({element, offset}) instead of setting style.transform. Same overlap for intervention markers placed on a post.

integration_issues.issue: Blocked by backend /controlroom/events org-context bug above. With that list mocked via route interception, the read-only UI is correct: status badge cr-status shown, no status select/settings/NUOVO INTERVENTO/import/add/place/edit/duplicate/delete buttons, presence buttons disabled, markers not draggable.

issues: Tabs row overflows: 'Avvisi' + red badge clipped at right edge (cr-tab-alerts exceeds panel width also on mobile)
Resource filter selects truncated to 'Tutti i tip', 'Tutti gli s', 'Tutti i sel', 'Tutte le p' - use 2x2 grid
Post category 'Ambulanza' and vehicle 'Ambulanza' produce two identical-looking chips; prefix vehicle chips (e.g. 'Mezzo: Ambulanza') or group them
useEffect depends on d.settings, so any live reload (5s polling, other operator change) resets unsaved edits in the open settings dialog

action_items: Make /api/controlroom/events, /status, /confirmation resolve the active org from X-Org-Id (same dependency as /ops) so multi-org collaboratori see the org's events; compute can_purchase on the resolved role
Fix map fullscreen: portal to document.body (or remove transform on control-room-page ancestor) so exit button is always on screen (mobile + desktop)
Use maplibregl.Marker offset option for resource/intervention markers so post markers stay visible/clickable
Minor: tabs/filters overflow in side panel; duplicate 'Ambulanza' chips; settings dialog reset on live reload
critical_code_review_comments: controlroom.py Phase-1 endpoints use get_current_user (primary org) while controlroom_ops uses require_admin (acting org) -> inconsistent tenant context between list and ops
OpsMap re-creates all DOM markers on every data refresh (each rev change); acceptable now but costly with hundreds of posts/resources
PUT generic update replaces whole document fields; presence endpoint lacks version check
Phones correctly masked server-side when perms.contacts false (code path reviewed; no test account without contacts permission available - collaboratore C has contacts=true)

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 phase2 + 14/14 phase1 regression); 1 org-context bug found by UI testing in Phase-1 list endpoint
success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all admin flows work; fullscreen broken, marker overlap, collaboratore cannot reach dashboard)

seed_data_creation: None persistent. All TEST_/TEST_UI records (sectors, posts, resources incl. 2 staff imports Mario/Paolo, interventions) deleted by id; event settings restored (status preparazione, responsabile null, Ristoro label). Original data intact: Settore 1, Ristoro km 2, AMB1, Lucia/Giulia, Malore km 3.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via page.request.post('/api/auth/login') then goto /control-room?event=09e1b85e1b774b79956a31fd139a60c8. For collaboratore C set localStorage acting_org_id=9bb535b289f74a2395a6114ff0e2f0b5 (org switcher testid org-switcher-select). Run pytest with -n 0 (module fixtures share state). Retest: C sees event list in org A, fullscreen map covers viewport with visible exit button at 390px, post markers not hidden by .cr-res markers (compare bounding boxes).
rca of the issue: 1) controlroom.build passes deps['get_current_user'] as 'member' for list/status; get_current_user returns primary org_id, X-Org-Id membership switching is applied only in require_admin. 2) position:fixed inside an element with a non-none transform (animate-fade-up keeps transform after animation) is positioned relative to that element, not the viewport. 3) maplibre Marker writes element.style.transform on every render/position update, discarding the custom translate.
